prompts.VoyageShip:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG cutout of the player expedition ship for a 2D dark fantasy Korean game.
Input image: style and world reference only, an old lighthouse keep on a cold night coast. Design a NEW original vessel consistent with its black iron, weathered wood, brass and warm lantern light.
Subject: a modest 20-meter coastal lighthouse tender and salvage expedition ship, full vessel in three-quarter broadside view, bow facing SCREEN RIGHT. Deep navy-black riveted hull, weathered timber deck, brass protective ribs, compact inhabited cabin with warm amber windows, one large caged navigation lantern above the cabin, short smokestack, small folded mast, ropes, anchor, lifebuoy and a few modest supply crates. Capable of carrying the protagonist and four companions. Sober gothic adventure mood, readable silhouette at 300px wide, detailed hand-painted dark fantasy game illustration with clean silhouette.
Composition: 1536x1024 transparent canvas; entire ship including keel, stern and bow visible; centered, 10 percent clear padding every edge. No people. No water, sea, harbor, buildings, floor, cast shadow or background. Genuine transparent alpha around the ship. No UI, border, text, nameplate letters, flags with symbols, watermark, laser, magical beam or battleship weapons. Restrained warm lantern core, no giant outward glow. The ship itself is the only subject.
prompts.VoyageSea:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 backdrop for an interactive coastal voyage route map in a 2D dark fantasy game.
Input image: style and world reference only; match the old lighthouse keep, cold midnight colors and warm amber points of light.
Create an original wide 2048x1152 hand-painted oblique bird's-eye coastal sea chart illustration, viewed from high above a drowned gothic archipelago at eternal night. Deep muted navy water and soft blue-gray fog, weathered rocky islands with a few distant ruined towers and abandoned landing jetties along the outer edges, one small lighthouse on the FAR LEFT coast with a tiny warm beacon. Center 70 percent is calm dark open water suitable for drawing interactive route nodes over it, clean low contrast, no busy detail. Distant cliffs and mist at the top edge, faint quiet wave texture, occasional warm harbor dots near coastline, subtle map-like etched contour accents only near the edges, restrained painterly atmospheric depth.
No drawn routes, dotted lines, nodes, stage markers, compass, text, numbers, borders, UI panels, characters, ship, logo, watermark or overlays. It must be a beautiful atmospheric ocean background, not a finished UI screen. Avoid bright moon, bright sky gradients, huge central islands and giant light beams. Solid opaque background.
